title: Unit Event — This Moment With You! — Episode3 Meeting Her

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need's debut single is taking off. Thanks to the impact of their VIRTUAL SINGER version, their label expresses hopes that the band will create VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all future songs. But Ichika seems hesitant...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, these are... Lady's tresses.
It's cute how they have so many little flowers coiled around them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a nice find.
You're up to ten now, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Yup! I'm almost done making my flower encyclopedia for school!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks for helping me, Dad.
My plan was to make this with Saki and the others, but we couldn't find a good time to meet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line:
I had fun during our walk as well.
Thank you for inviting me, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm really glad...!
I'm gonna show Mom once it's finished.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line: Yes, she's going to be so proud.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, they're selling gelato over there...
It's starting to get a little warm, so why don't we go buy some?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm still not finished with my encyclopedia...

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line: Haha. Then, I'll go buy some while you keep working on that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line: Here, I'll even leave the tablet with you so that you can look up any other new flowers you find.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... What other flowers are there...?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, those pink ones!
I'll use them.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
What are these?
I'll try looking them up on the tablet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Thanks for coming today, everyone!
I hope you're looking forward to hearing me sing a lot!>

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (I tapped something and made Dad's tablet play this video...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, she started singing...
I've never heard this song before...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Her voice is beautiful...
And it's so cool how she can play the guitar...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line: Ichika, I got some of that gelato for us. Let's have this while we take a break.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Dad, look!
This Hatsune Miku person's video popped up, and she's really cool!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: The song from this video's also really cool...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (That other song was also pretty cool, but this one feels more like one that an idol would sing. It's really cute...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (It's so interesting how the same Miku can sing all these different types of songs...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (That also goes for each video. And depending on what she's singing, she'll sound cute, cool, grown-up and stuff... It's like she's someone new every time.)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (But it's the same Hatsune Miku in all of them...)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I still think this song's the coolest...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: She shines so bright, and she sounds like she's having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to be just like her!)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: We should play a Miku song together!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Miku...? As in Hatsune Miku?
The VIRTUAL SINGER?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Have you always liked Miku, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
I just found out about her yesterday!
Here, this song... You need to hear it!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, this is a pretty cool song...

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: But how are we supposed to play this?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Does that mean we're forming a band?
I can play the bass.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Oh, my mom taught me how to play the piano! I can play that!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Not many bands have pianos.
What if you played the keyboard?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Like an electronic one?
I can play one of those♪

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: My dad owns a guitar, so I'll ask to see if I can borrow it!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I-It's not like he's said yes yet...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
But I'm sure he will.
I mean, your dad's such a nice person.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: What other instruments do bands have...?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
Drums...
Like the ones in the music room?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: But I've never played the drums before...

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
What?! A-As in singing?
No, I can't do that...!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what about the triangle or recorder?!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: But we're talking about a band here.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Honami...
I didn't mean to make you panic or anything.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: But would you be willing to give it a try...?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: You can always pick a different instrument if you think they're too hard to play after you try practicing with them.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I've never played the guitar before either, so I have no idea how that's going to go...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: But I want to play with you, Honami. I want us to all play together...!
